name: Aleph
execution_role: Initiation/origination primitive — the glyph that begins an execution chain or asserts primacy within a jurisdiction (pairs naturally with RFC-0002's "Jurisdiction" concept as the entity that opens one).

name: Bet
execution_role: Containment/boundary-forming primitive — defines a Semantic Node's enclosed scope; a natural candidate for marking where a Jurisdiction's interior begins.

name: Gimel
pictograph_meaning: Camel, foot that walks, to carry
execution_role: Transfer/traversal primitive — moves a value, state, or agent from one Semantic Node to an adjacent one. Likely pairs with node_adjacency relationships directly.

name: Dalet
execution_role: Threshold/gate primitive — governs whether traversal (Gimel) is permitted between two nodes; an access-control or conditional-passage function.

name: Hey
execution_role: Perception/revelation primitive — makes an otherwise hidden node, profile, or agent state observable to another agent; likely relevant to RFC-0008 (Memory, Experience, Knowledge Formation).

name: Vav
execution_role: Connective/binding primitive — the literal conjunction operator; creates or reinforces an edge (node_adjacency) rather than traversing one.

name: Zayin
execution_role: Division/severance primitive — breaks a connection (undoes Vav), splits a jurisdiction, or terminates an agent's access to a node.

name: Het
execution_role: Protection/isolation primitive — hardens a Jurisdiction's boundary against unauthorized traversal or perception; a defensive counterpart to Dalet's gate.

name: Tet
execution_role: Encirclement/weaving primitive — wraps multiple nodes or roots into a single higher-order structure (a candidate mechanism for how a Semantic Profile aggregates multiple Latin Roots into one glyph).

name: Yod
execution_role: Action/execution primitive proper — the glyph that actually *does* something rather than describing structure; likely the closest thing to a generic "verb" operator in the Hebrew Execution Calculus (RFC-0013).

name: Kaf
pictograph_meaning: Open palm, to bend, allow, cover
execution_role: Permission/modulation primitive — bends or conditions the effect of another glyph rather than acting independently; an operator-modifier, not a standalone verb.

name: Lamed
pictograph_meaning: Staff, goad, to teach, authority, yoke
execution_role: Instruction/authority primitive — imposes a rule or constraint on subordinate glyphs/agents; plausible mechanism for RFC-0006's "Emergent Symbolic Law."

name: Mem
execution_role: Propagation/flow primitive — the carrier of symbolic waves across jurisdictions (RFC-0003's field dynamics / wave propagation discussion maps closely here).

name: Nun
execution_role: Generative/continuation primitive — spawns a new node, agent, or epoch; a candidate root mechanism for RFC-0016's "Constitutional Evolution and Epoch Transitions."

name: Samekh
pictograph_meaning: Support, prop, to grab hold, turn
execution_role: Stabilization primitive — holds a state constant against propagating change (Mem); a plausible "persistence" or "checkpoint" operator.

name: Ayin
execution_role: Cognition/evaluation primitive — the mechanism by which an Indus Icon Agent forms Deliberation/Intention (RFC-0009), distinct from Hey's raw perception.

name: Pey
execution_role: Communication/broadcast primitive — the mechanism for RFC-0010's "Collective Symbolic Construction and Negotiated Meaning" between agents.

name: Tsade
execution_role: Pursuit/goal-directed primitive — encodes an agent's active intention toward a target node or resource; the "wanting" component of Deliberation (RFC-0009).

name: Qof
pictograph_meaning: Circle, back of head, horizon, gather, time
execution_role: Cyclical/temporal primitive — governs Turns/Rounds (RFC-0004's Temporal Cognition); the mechanism that closes a loop and advances the world's discrete clock.

name: Resh
execution_role: Identity/agency primitive — marks something as a discrete Indus Icon Agent rather than passive lattice structure (RFC-0002 §3.6); the "this is a someone, not a something" marker.

name: Shin
execution_role: Transformation/consumption primitive — irreversibly converts one symbolic state into another; the destructive/generative counterpart pair with Nun.

name: Tav
execution_role: Sealing/finalization primitive — closes a Turn, ratifies a Constitutional change (RFC-0015/0016), or commits a state as immutable. Natural candidate for the "commit" operation in the Hebrew Execution Calculus.
